name: ck12_18_cheat_parsing
description: Test 18 (CK10, CK11). Leading, trailing and repeated blanks are one break: '  Stopwatch   pause  ' pauses. An argument that starts and ends with a quote loses that pair: 'Stopwatch "pause"' pauses. A separator inside an odd number of quotes is kept: 'Stopwatch "pa use"' gives 'pa use' (nothing). No inner quote is removed: 'Stopwatch pa"use' does nothing. atol wraps in 32 bits: 'WhatTimeIzIt -1' is SetHour(4294967295), 15:00; 'WhatTimeIzIt 4294967303' wraps to 7, 07:00; 'Stopwatch magnify 3000000000' wraps negative and is clamped to 0.05. The registration order (test 19, CK12, CK13) is in ck12_01_construction.
